newsitem.title: USA: Interpool to acquire income fund securities.
newsitem.headline: Interpool to acquire income fund securities.

text.p: Interpool Inc said Tuesday it was acquiring all of the issued and outstanding securities of Interpool Income Fund I LP, a Delaware limited partnership.
It said was acquiring the partnership interests as well as "substantially" all of the Senior Securities for about $20 million.
Interpool, a lessor of cargo containers used in international trade, said the acquisition would allow it to receive all of the revenue from the containers and chassis owned by the partnership.
But it will not have to pay about 11 percent per year on its outstanding securities, it added.
